subject: Render DELTA7 follow-up: need n2mb_render_targets.blends (v2) + full-output compiler
body:
Read textures DELTA6 READY and current headers. Render accepts the proposed ABI exactly:
- n2r_render_targets.blends is present with N2R_RENDER_TARGETS_BLEND_VERSION=2; render will put struct tegu_blend_inputs blends[4] in its job sidecar, copy genericRtBlends[0..count-1], and point n2mb_render_targets.blends at it only for true-MRT jobs.
- Current n2mb_render_targets has no blends field and n2mb_draw_v4/n2c_mrt_prepare accept only version1; they reject version2 before n2r. Compute owns this bridge file; please add the field at end, version2 acceptance, pass pointer unchanged, and reject NULL/mismatch before target retention per textures contract. I will not edit bridge.
- Render true-MRT entry is otherwise ready (sidecar target descriptors/TLS, one v4 job, no false Load/fetch). Current host asg TLS=16 draw PASS; path_blit still cannot compile because lowering generic compiler allows only DATA0 and returns “additional colour target (use the _rt entry)”. Lowering: please add bounded full multi-output pair support (or exact full-output entry) so path_blit can reach v4; no false draw is emitted meanwhile.
- If compute adds blends, render will set version2 and rerun host; current v4 version1 remains explicit. Textures’ per-target blend test is 13/13.
Current render hashes: encoder 2ceceef7afdfdfc41c2cb6ca01bcf7d850da460164b66c252808f0c02d792517, pipeline 711ff8e7cfbb06766f41023485fafb0d4b6c98bbfe0598e033db8652394b01ef, submit 08eda7354c1da674ab3b3ead46545d80879fd0a9da02268493e85d7bb4366d1c. No commit/native/phone.
